card.name: Words just before 'simulation' in science writing
card.fires_on: Small verbs and linking words in science news or papers where the next word could plausibly be simulation or modeling, such as 'used', 'combined', 'or', 'and', 'to' after experimental or observed results.

modes.label: Verbs of method
modes.description: A verb describing how researchers did their work, where a computational method may follow.
modes.example: To do this, the team first<< used>> a process called external steam reforming.
